rows.note: The Safety policy states 'The speed limit in the yard is 10 mph', so the expected answer is the handbook's own words.
The handbook says 'Complete the following training within your first 30 days' and names security awareness, health and safety, and data protection.
The expenses policy says claims over £500 and up to £5,000 are approved by your department head, and £3,000 falls in that band.
The Flights section says flights of 6 hours or more may be booked in premium economy, and 9 hours is over that threshold.
The mileage policy gives 25 pence per mile after the first 10,000 business miles in a tax year, which is the band the last 2,000 of 12,000 fall in.
